request:
Look up these separately, return signature + import + whether stable/experimental:
1. @wordpress/components ProgressBar component: is it exported as `ProgressBar` (stable) or `__experimentalProgressBar`? Props (value, className)?
2. @wordpress/editor PluginPrePublishPanel and PluginSidebar: confirm they are exported from @wordpress/editor (current), props.
3. @wordpress/data createReduxStore: are thunks enabled by default (thunk args { dispatch, select, registry })? Is `createSelector` exported from @wordpress/data?
4. core/editor store actions lockPostSaving(lockName), lockPostAutosaving(lockName), unlockPostSaving, unlockPostAutosaving signatures.
5. PHP filter `block_editor_rest_api_preload_paths` signature.

results.note: Exported as stable `ProgressBar` from @wordpress/components; the page does not mention `__experimentalProgressBar`. DEPRECATED since WordPress 7.3, scheduled for removal in 7.5. Use `Progress` from `@wordpress/ui` instead (migration guide linked on the page). The section was truncated before the Props table (next heading 'Props'), but the usage text covers `value` (0 to 100; omit for indeterminate) and `className`. No full props table was retrieved.

Exported from @wordpress/editor (listed on the @wordpress/editor package page). Props: className [string], title [string], initialOpen [boolean] (always open when no title is given), icon [WPBlockTypeIconRender], children [React.ReactNode]. Returns React.ReactNode. No deprecation notice on the page.

Listed on the @wordpress/editor package page, so it is exported from there (the usage example reads `wp.editor.PluginSidebar`). The retrieved section shows only the example props `name`, `title` and `icon`, and mentions `isPinnable`. It has no formal props list, so a full props table was not found. No deprecation notice seen. The section was flagged truncated; the next heading is PluginSidebarMoreMenuItem.

Signature: createReduxStore( key: string, options: ReduxStoreConfig< State, Actions, Selectors > ) returns StoreDescriptor. The page does NOT say whether thunks are enabled by default or what thunk args are ({ dispatch, select, registry }). That was not verified. Not stated as an experimental API.

Yes, `createSelector` is documented on the @wordpress/data package page. It is re-exported from the `rememo` package. The page gives no import line, but by the same pattern it would be `import { createSelector } from '@wordpress/data'`. That is inferred, not confirmed by the page.
results.snippet: ( selector: S, getDependants: GetDependants ) => S & EnhancedSelector

results.note: lockPostSaving( lockName: string ) returns an action object (Object). Usage: wp.data.dispatch( 'core/editor' ).lockPostSaving( 'futurelock' ). The other three actions are in the entries below, each taking `lockName` (string) and returning an Action object.
lockPostAutosaving( lockName: string ) returns an action object (Object).
results.snippet:
// Lock post autosaving with the lock key `mylock`:
wp.data.dispatch( 'core/editor' ).lockPostAutosaving( 'mylock' );

results.note: unlockPostSaving( lockName: string ) returns an action object (Object).
results.snippet:
// Unlock post saving with the lock key `mylock`:
wp.data.dispatch( 'core/editor' ).unlockPostSaving( 'mylock' );

results.note: unlockPostAutosaving( lockName: string ) returns an action object (Object). The page's own code comment says 'Unlock post saving', but the call is unlockPostAutosaving.
results.snippet:
// Unlock post saving with the lock key `mylock`:
wp.data.dispatch( 'core/editor' ).unlockPostAutosaving( 'mylock' );

results.note: Filter hook with two parameters: $preload_paths ((string|string[])[], the paths to preload) and $block_editor_context (WP_Block_Editor_Context, the current block editor context). Introduced in 5.8.0.

unresolved.reason: The createReduxStore section does not mention thunks. I did not fetch any other page for it, so the question remains unanswered.
